reported_season: 冬季至早春（北台灣基隆附近岩岸成魚群聚觀察）
reported_pattern: Adults tended to aggregate in winter and early spring in the sampled northern Taiwan rocky-shore population; this is a seasonal aggregation observation, not a fishing success season.
method: monthly shore sampling; 241 adults and 5 juveniles
limitations: Historical single-site northern Taiwan sample; no East Taiwan monthly catch rate or modern validation. Candidate c001 is a vernacular black-hair alias gate; require individual morphological identification before species-level inference.

reported_season: 1–4月；日本研究場域中水溫低於約16.9°C時較常觀察到大型群聚
reported_pattern: Large aggregations around breakwaters were observed frequently from January to April in the study area; the reported temperature association is study-specific and must not be used as a universal threshold.
geographic_scope: 日本壹岐市和歌漁港及九州西部／東南部驗證地點
life_stage: identified Kyphosus bigibbus; life-stage details not specified in register
method: 2010–2015 diver visual surveys across multiple sites
limitations: Japanese breakwater aggregation observations are not Taiwan East Coast shore-fishing catch data. Applies only to confirmed K. bigibbus; do not transfer to K. cinerascens or all white-hair vernacular records.

reported_season: 春季至6月上旬（北台灣石門；幼魚覓食與成魚繁殖的近岸群聚觀察）
reported_pattern: The explanatory source describes juvenile fish approaching algae-rich shore pools to feed and adults approaching algal reefs to reproduce; nearshore groups were more often seen through May to early June, then declined as temperature rose and algae diminished.
geographic_scope: 北台灣石門海岸潮池及海藻礁
study_period: Article published 2024-07-01; underlying observation dates and annual replication not specified
method: secondary natural-history explanatory article; not a standardized long-term survey
limitations: Secondary explanatory source, not primary quantitative study. Specific to northern Taiwan; do not infer East Taiwan season or bite probability. Juvenile feeding aggregation and adult reproductive aggregation are distinct behaviours.

reported_season: 12月至翌年4月（西台灣沿岸刺網漁獲與棲地模型）
reported_pattern: Gillnet catch and habitat modelling showed higher coastal concentration from December to April, associated with the reproductive season in the western Taiwan study.
method: gillnet catch locations plus remote-sensing environmental variables and seasonal MaxEnt model
limitations: Western Taiwan gillnet seasonal distribution is not East Taiwan shore-angling activity, spawning timing at every coast, or catch probability. Gear, habitat and oceanography differ.

reported_season: 4–6月及10–12月為主要商業盛漁期；1–3月作業集中新港外海、4–6月向東南、10–12月向北至花蓮
reported_pattern: A Taiwan East Coast study using 88,902 fish-market specimens from 2003–2018 and 2012–2018 longline-vessel operation records reported major fishing seasons in April–June and October–December. About 75% of January–March trips operated offshore of Chenggong; grounds shifted southeast in April–June and north toward Hualien in October–December.
geographic_scope: 台灣東部離岸商業延繩釣漁場（非岸際釣點）
life_stage: adult/marketed fish; life stage not separately resolved for all samples
method: fish-market biological sampling plus commercial longline vessel operation records and fishing-ground analysis
limitations: Commercial offshore longline and market samples are not shore-angling catch data. Seasonal catch and effort patterns cannot be converted into nearshore presence, hourly activity, best shore-fishing months, or catch probability; fishing-ground shifts are also influenced by fleet effort and operation locations.

reported_season: 3–8月為產卵階段；4–7月產卵比例最高（雌魚GSI高峰4–6月、雄魚5–7月）
reported_pattern: Monthly 2020 samples from Taitung XinGang fish market included 358 skipjack tuna caught in Eastern Taiwan waters. Gonad histology identified spawning-stage females from March to August, with the highest spawning proportion from April to July; female GSI peaked April–June and male GSI May–July.
geographic_scope: 台灣東部離岸商業漁業；台東新港魚市場
method: monthly fish-market sampling and gonad histology; 358 gonad specimens
limitations: Reproductive timing is not a fishing-activity or catch-rate measure. Market specimens represent commercial catches and do not establish nearshore availability, hourly activity, shore-fishing success, or a universal annual window; study covers one calendar year.

reported_season: 5–10月繁殖活動；5月與7月兩次高峰（1986年北台灣研究）
reported_pattern: 1986年北台灣沿岸調查169天，共記錄966個巢，其中58天觀察到產卵；首次產卵5月1日，最後一次10月16日，5月及7月有兩次高峰。研究指出產卵時序與較高浮游動物產量相關，未發現與水溫、月相或近岸流速的顯著關聯。
method: 水下產卵巢調查及每日產卵強度分析
limitations: 北台灣單一研究地點及1986年資料；巢數不代表魚群數量或釣獲率，不可外推成東部最佳釣期或即時活動分數。
